canada.title: Mississauga man convicted in U.S. terror probe gets additional 50-year prison sentence
canada.summary: A Mississauga man serving a 40-year sentence for terror-related charges in the U.S. was sentenced to an additional 50 years in federal prison in relation to an assault against two corrections officers, the U.S. Attorney's Office announced Monday.

canada.title: 'Let's do it right': N.W.T. downstream leaders and advocates on Alta. oilsands tailings release
canada.summary: Advocates and Indigenous communities call for federal and N.W.T. leaders to review Suncor’s proposed oilsands tailings release into the Athabasca River system, citing major scientific data gaps and a moral duty to protect downstream waters.

canada.title: Whitehorse staff tables draft downtown trail plan
canada.summary: Draft trail plan includes locations of two potential bridges spanning the Yukon River

canada.title: Convicted harasser began tormenting new and old victims 'almost immediately' after parole expired: documents
canada.summary: Warrant documents provide a detailed look at Agnieszka Ciochon-Newton's alleged campaign of harassment against family members, her former parole officer and a sitting judge.

canada.title: Subtropical storm bringing rain and wind to parts of Atlantic Canada, diverts cruise ship
canada.summary: Environment Canada has issued yellow rainfall warnings for parts of northern and eastern Nova Scotia Thursday with rainfall amounts of 50 to 70 millimetres.

canada.title: Come see Quebec's most famous painter's works: Espace Riopelle opens in Quebec City
canada.summary: Montreal-born Jean Paul Riopelle is considered one of Canada’s most influential painters. The new Espace Riopelle at the Musée national des beaux-arts du Québec offers Quebecers a chance to experience his work in person.

canada.title: Mayor of Frampton Que., announces she will stay on after wave of resident support
canada.summary: A petition with 400 resident signatures has prompted Gina Cloutier, mayor of Frampton, Que., to reverse her decision to resign. She'd initially announced her intention to step down due to threats of violence from her constituents.

canada.title: Fact-checking the B.C. NDP's record — and major parties' promises — on seniors care
canada.summary: The B.C. NDP promised to add 5,400 new long-term care beds to the system in 2024. They also pledged to expand access to home care, to enable seniors who want to live at home to continue to do so. Here’s a look at what they delivered and what the major parties are promising to do if elected.

canada.title: Gusty winds, rain and even some snowfall expected for parts of N.L.
canada.summary: Windy weather is forecasted for parts of Newfoundland starting Friday afternoon, with some places being advised to brace for snowfall.

canada.title: ‘I want an answer’: Police board learns Halifax RCMP aren’t going ahead with satellite offices
canada.summary: RCMP will do a pilot project in Beechville-Lakeside-Timberlea instead of opening new office.

canada.title: Fall storm could bring 15-25 cm of snow to northern Manitoba
canada.summary: A "significant fall storm" is headed to northern Manitoba, bringing rain that will transition into heavy, wet snow with as much as 15 to 25 centimetres expected, says Environment Canada.

canada.title: Alberta's referendum count still not complete, results to be delayed
canada.summary: As of early Thursday morning, the final ballots for Alberta's remaining referendum questions have still not been counted.

canada.title: Firm behind planned Anthropic data centre in Nova Scotia denies owing fees to N.L.
canada.summary: EverWind, a company planning a massive data centre in Nova Scotia for artificial intelligence giant Anthropic, is in the midst of a dispute about land fees for a failed wind-powered hydrogen project in southern Newfoundland.

canada.title: Spending millions on industrial development incentives worth it, Edmonton mayor says
canada.summary: Commercial real estate developers told Edmonton city councillors Wednesday that two proposed incentive programs would remove barriers to new industrial projects in the city.

canada.title: Tumbler Ridge conspiracy suspect James Bryant pleads not guilty in U.S. court
canada.summary: The alleged co-conspirator in the deadly mass shooting in Tumbler Ridge, B.C., has pleaded not guilty in a U.S. court and is set to go on trial in December.

canada.title: Saskatoon heritage panel debates unapproved deck at century-old house
canada.summary: Owners of a 1917 house with heritage designation say they tried to resolve the issue with city officials before demolishing an existing deck without the proper permission and building a new one.

canada.title: WHL commissioner reviews state of the league in Sask. and beyond
canada.summary: Dan Near speaks about the health of local teams in the changing junior hockey landscape, rising costs, possible expansion, streaming and league safety standards.

canada.title: Officials to provide update on fatal fire at CFB Wainwright in Alberta
canada.summary: Officials are set to provide an update today about a devastating fire at a Canadian military base in Alberta that left four soldiers dead and dozens more injured.
